mechanism.fact: The character server marks the fixture online upon successful map authentication, before full map initialization.
Map authentication ACK and logged-in notice precede registry completion setting state.active=1.
An inactive EOF emits the exact Player AID/CID logged-off template and calls map_quit, not active clif_quitsave.
Inactive map_quit deletes a matching non-logout auth node and returns. Neither this branch nor chrif_auth_delete sends offline notification or a final save.

The over-60-second authentication cleanup sends offline only for auth nodes still present; an EOF-deleted node no longer reaches this timer. A generic wait of 60 seconds is therefore not a guaranteed cure.
Explicit 0x2B17 is 10 bytes (char ID at 2, account ID at 6), reaching char_set_char_offline and its SQL online=0 update.

Periodic 0x2AFE carries a count, not a per-character offline update. Full 0x2AFF membership reconciliation is called on map/char readiness; char cleanup runs every 600 seconds and clears server=-2, not every online record on a healthy known map server.

server_offline_visibility.assessment: The observed inactive EOF plus the reviewed branch strongly supports a startup-abort offline-notification gap. Native transport termination and SQL online visibility are distinct. No packet trace proves a specific 0x2B17 transmission/absence at the inter-server socket, and no server auth-node memory snapshot was taken.
server_offline_visibility.separate_source_weakness: chmapif_parse_setcharoffline checks RFIFOREST < 6 but reads through byte 9 and skips 10; dispatcher calls the handler without a 10-byte table gate. This is a pinned source short-frame weakness, not evidence it caused this run. The observed inactive map_quit branch does not send 0x2B17. No patch or fabricated fragmentation capture was made.
